principles.rule: one unmistakable first read per page
global asymmetry with locally readable clusters
visible hero/support/micro image hierarchy; avoid equal photo slots
use background/atmosphere, information surface, and foreground accent planes
use at least one controlled edge/bleed gesture when semantically appropriate while keeping critical text safe
group by meaning such as photo+label+caption or time+activity+micro-photo instead of generic UI cards
selective small rotation, optical alignment, taped/polaroid/ribbon gestures; never randomize everything
hero title must have a recognizable visual silhouette beyond just large bold type
create magazine density with useful short reads, never invented filler facts
one dominant, one support, one surprise accent plus stable reading ink/paper

fatalAiTells: identical corner radii across most content
all photos same size aspect and frame
same dominant rhythm on every page
generic luxury whitespace replacing editorial density
stickers used only to fill holes
generated fake text in production graphics
reference or dummy artwork treated as production
body copy shrunk to preserve decoration
adjacentPageVariation: do not repeat hero position by default
do not repeat identical photo-frame rhythm
do not repeat the same title alignment
do not repeat the same dominant color by default
comparisonLoop: capture current screenshot at thumbnail scale
compare first read image-scale variation useful reading destinations card-likeness edge overlap title silhouette and A5 readability
make one structural correction before micro-spacing
never solve weak reference match by merely adding stickers
antiOverfit: copy editorial behavior, not literal layout
do not copy reference fake text, people, logos or invented travel facts
do not force every page to match the same reference density if the semantic page job is quieter
readability, factual correctness, editability, mask safety and print constraints override literal similarity
